tracking_policy.weekly: Only specific actions linked to a verifiable monthly deliverable count as tasks. Guidance is not checkbox.
tracking_policy.monthly: A deliverable is complete automatically when all its linked applicable weekly steps are done, or when user explicitly verifies delivery early.
tracking_policy.quarterly: Execution completion derives from verified monthly deliverables, using period-linked months. KPI outcomes displayed separately.
tracking_policy.annual: Annual outcome is NOT automatically achieved by checkboxes. Verified KPI actuals and objective assessment govern achievement.
tracking_policy.early_completion: If work is done ahead of schedule, user can Verify now on the monthly deliverable. Linked weekly steps become satisfied, and quarter/annual execution progress updates.
tracking_policy.skipped: Skipped/N/A never means achieved; an applicable deliverable must be manually verified if a critical linked step is skipped.
